Name: effortless-rulebook-editor-runtime
Description: Generic in-container pipeline: rulebook -> Postgres -> read-only Node API + Vite admin portal (with RuleSpeak, RuleSpeak-DE, and XLSX export tabs). Baked into the effortless-rulebook-editor image; not project-specific.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktopostgres
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate Postgres SQL from the mounted rulebook

ProjectTranspilers.Name: chmodinitdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: rulebook-to-postgres emits init-db.sh without the execute bit set. The -exec engine passes NO arguments through to the invoked command (confirmed empirically: `-exec chmod +x ./init-db.sh` fails with 'missing operand' -- everything after the command token is swallowed), so this indirects through a tiny wrapper script (chmod-initdb.sh, placed in /postgres by container-entrypoint.sh) that takes no CLI args of its own.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: initdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Drop + recreate the in-container Postgres DB from the freshly generated SQL. Connection string comes from the DATABASE_URL env var (exported by container-entrypoint.sh) rather than a CLI arg, since -exec does not pass arguments through to the invoked command.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoviteadminportal
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the read-only Vite admin UI, unified with tabs for the Postgres schema, RuleSpeak (EN/DE), and XLSX export

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeak
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the plain-English RuleSpeak document (rulespeak.html), served under the portal's RuleSpeak tab

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeakde
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the German RuleSpeak document (rulespeak.html), served under the portal's RuleSpeak (DE) tab

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoxlsx
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate an Excel workbook snapshot of the rulebook's tables, offered as a download from the portal's Export tab
